**One urgent addition to §1's scope, found by the validator's first run:** the 2026-07-04 slay-the-spire scout run drifted to an off-spec schema (`okf_version: 1.0`, `document_type`, `game_slug`, named source ids like `official-rulebook` instead of `src-NNN`, no `status`) — 46 findings. When updating the scout for 0.2, **pin its output format hard to OKF_SPEC.md** (ideally: have the scout run `node scripts/validate-okf.mjs` on its own output before pushing, and treat findings as a failed run). The librarian will migrate the already-drifted docs, but prevention belongs in the scout.

Also note the validator's controlled vocab lives at the top of `scripts/validate-okf.mjs` (better-if labels kebab-cased; mechanics currently shape-checked only) — when §1 pins the mechanics vocabulary, add it there and in OKF_SPEC.md together.

Status update: **the remaining scope (§1, §2, §5, §6) is implemented in PR #4.**

- **§1** — `OKF_SPEC.md` bumped to 0.2 with `mechanics` / `better_if_labels` / `game.weight`; a 45-slug mechanics vocabulary pinned in the spec and mirrored in `scripts/validate-okf.mjs` (membership now enforced, both copies updated together as requested); all 55 docs across the five games backfilled.
- **§1 urgent addition (scout format pinning)** — the spec's output contract and `operations.okf.md` now require every scout run to validate its own output (`node scripts/validate-okf.mjs`, findings = failed run) and regenerate the index before pushing.
- **§2** — `scripts/generate-index.mjs` generates `INDEX.okf.md` (game table + inverted mechanics → games table); the validator diffs it on every full run, so a stale INDEX fails CI.
- **§5** — wishlist-first selection doctrine landed in `operations.okf.md`, `README.md`, and the scout-report template.
- **§6** — adopted the no-raw-stashing recommendation: structured `followups:` blocks in scout-report frontmatter (enums validated; required non-empty on `needs_followup` scout reports). Mage Knight's three failed WizKids PDFs are backfilled as followups entries; the librarian command consumes these blocks.

Once #4 merges, all six sections of this proposal are landed and this issue can be closed.
